forecasts.question: Will Hormuz reach >=50 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-07-02?
forecasts.delta_reason: Judge reduces from Analyst 0.28 to 0.12. Resolution requires >=50 commercial transits/day as a 7-day moving average by EOD 2026-07-02 — 7 days from today. IMF PortWatch records ~5 commercial transits/day as of 21 June (corroborated by Analyst noting 7-day avg through 14 June was 2.57). NBC 25 transits on 23 June may be partially commercial but PortWatch definition mismatch is unresolved; CENTCOM 55 on 20 June almost certainly includes military/escort tonnage. Six P&I clubs have not reinstated coverage; war-risk premium at 8x. Without P&I reinstatement, most operators cannot legally transit. A sustained 7-day average of 50+ commercial vessels starting today is structurally blocked by insurance and mine-risk constraints. Kpler 30-day projection to 40/day does not meet the criterion before 2 July.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch (or equivalent AIS) records >=50 commercial transits/day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-02.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch + one TIER1/OSINT shipping report (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted convoys count; one-off surge days below a 7-day window do NOT qualify; if PortWatch unpublished, use best AIS tracker and flag AMBIGUOUS if sources conflict >20%.

forecasts.question: Will Iran and the US reach and publicly announce a comprehensive final deal (ending the war, addressing nuclear enrichment, and specifying a sanctions-relief schedule) before EOD 2026-08-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast. A 60-day roadmap was agreed at Burgenstock (21-22 June) with three working groups: nuclear issues, sanctions, monitoring. Major unresolved issues: enrichment rights (Pezeshkian 23 June: Iran will 'never back down from right to enrich uranium'); HEU disposal; IAEA access dispute (Grossi vs unnamed Iranian diplomat on sequencing); sanctions-relief sequencing. Pezeshkian explicitly ruled out ballistic missile negotiations. Historical base rate for comprehensive nuclear agreements within 60 days from framework to signed deal is low.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports that the US and Iran have formally announced and signed a comprehensive final agreement that specifies (a) a permanent or long-term end to military hostilities, (b) a binding arrangement for Iran's nuclear program including enrichment levels or a moratorium, and (c) a concrete sanctions-relief schedule — all before EOD 2026-08-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera/CNBC/NPR, plus official US State Department or Iran MFA/IRNA confirmation.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Interim frameworks, extensions of the 60-day MOU without a final deal, or partial agreements covering only one of the three elements = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; a deal announced but not yet signed before EOD = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
